title: Q-CIFAIL-ultrastable-org-profile-probe: org-profile-probe is failing in ultrastable/ultrastable
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run and every ciwatch run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ciwatch --probe ultrastable/ultrastable org-profile-probe
**Status:** closed

CIWATCH-1: workflow `org-profile-probe` in ultrastable/ultrastable is red on its default branch (failure, 2026-11-23T18:27:09Z): https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable/actions/runs/45238533984

Fix the root cause in the repository where the defect lives; do not skip or weaken the check. Failed log tail:

```
xit 0
probe	Org page shows the profile	2026-11-23T18:27:13.4114098Z ^[[36;1mpage=$(curl -fsSL "https://github.com/$ORG") && echo "$page" | grep -qi "runs itself" && echo "ok: profile live" && exit 0^[[0m
probe	Org page shows the profile	2026-11-23T18:27:13.4115468Z ^[[36;1mecho "::error::https://github.com/$ORG does not show the profile"^[[0m

probe	Org page shows the profile	2026-11-23T18:27:13.4119107Z ^[[36;1m[ -n "$n" ] || gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --body "Probe failed. Owner: org-init. Check .github is unarchived+public and profile/README.md exists. Closing probe: this workflow passes."^[[0m
```

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-23T20:11:48Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-24T13:51:18Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: exit 0
